mapper.update: update vpn.wg_device_key set publicKey = #{publicKey} where devId = #{devId}
mapper.insert: insert into vpn.wg_device_key(devId, publicKey, addrIndex) values (#{devId}, #{publicKey}, #{addrIndex})
mapper.select: select min(c.i) from (select #{min} as i union all select addrIndex + 1 from vpn.wg_device_key) c left join vpn.wg_device_key t on t.addrIndex = c.i where t.addrIndex is null and c.i between #{min} and #{max}
select id, devId, publicKey, addrIndex from vpn.wg_device_key order by addrIndex
